title.es: Noche del censo en la granja

place: Farmhouse kitchen, Great House Farm, Llandough, Glamorgan
logline: The enumerator collects the household schedule and enters John Williams, 53, 'Farmer of 170 [or 120] ac.', his wife Mary and their children under the name 'Llandough Home Farm'.

moment.place: Farmhouse kitchen, Great House Farm, Llandough
moment.summary: The enumerator collects the household schedule and enters John Williams, 53, 'Farmer of 170 [or 120] ac.', his wife Mary and their children under the name 'Llandough Home Farm'.
captions: 1878–79: Ordnance Survey surveys Glamorgan six-inch sheet XLVII (Cardiff and Penarth area), published 1885 (CH-0027)
c.1878: OS large-scale Glamorgan sheets XLVII/2–15 cover Llandough-juxta-Penarth (Glamorgan Archives DCVG/PL/1) (CH-0028)
c.1880: 'Armour' is reported found under the floor of the rear wing of Great House. It is thought to be the medieval ironwork from Llandough now at the National Museum (CH-0029)
moment.basis: The 1881 census (RG11/5288 p.2; EV-0224) records the household. The kitchen collection on the day after census night is the most likely moment. On our reading, 'Llandough Home Farm' is Great House Farm.

continuity: Hold on the orchard beyond the yard hedge with the railway embankment behind it, then cut to the magistrates' court, where John Williams junior gives evidence about apples taken from the orchard of Great House Farm.
